disclaimer.short: This is an at-home observation, not a medical diagnosis. If you're worried about your cat, ask a veterinarian.

selectCat.heading: Which cat is this scan for?
selectCat.description: Attaching the right profile helps CatCheck track each cat's own pH over time.
selectCat.privacyNoteBody: CatCheck doesn't guess which cat it is. Please confirm the cat for this litter sample.
selectCat.sharedOptionDescription: Save to the shared log without attaching it to any cat's own readings.
selectCat.emptyDescription: Add a cat profile before you start scanning.
selectCat.loadError: Couldn't load your cats. Please try again.
selectCat.multiCatTipTitle: Several cats sharing a litter tray?
selectCat.multiCatTipBody: A common rule is N+1 trays for N cats — one tray per cat helps attach scan results to the right profile.

capture.guide: Take a close-up of the color-changed litter area, with good light and sharp focus.
capture.creditNote: Each analysis uses 1 scan from your package.
capture.missingCatDescription: Please go back and choose a cat before taking the photo.
capture.uploadError: Couldn't send the photo. Please try again.
capture.busyError: The system is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
capture.frameHint: Line up the color-changed granules inside the scan frame
capture.cameraDenied: CatCheck doesn't have camera permission. Allow the camera in your browser settings, or tap the capture button to open your device's camera.
capture.cameraUnavailable: Couldn't open the live camera. Tap the capture button to open your device's camera or choose a photo from your album.

errors.imageTooSmall: The photo is too small — move closer or choose a higher-resolution photo.
errors.imageTooLarge: The photo is larger than the allowed size. Please choose another one.
errors.imageUnsupported: This image format isn't supported — please use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.imageDecodeFailed: Couldn't read the image file — it may be corrupted. Please take the photo again.
errors.engineUnavailable: The image analyzer isn't available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.catUnavailable: The selected cat profile can't be used. Please choose the cat again.

analyzing.note: Each analysis uses 1 scan from your package.

result.imageAlt: Photo of the scanned litter area

inconclusive.title: Not enough data to estimate pH
inconclusive.description: The photo didn't meet the quality requirements, so the system couldn't estimate pH this time. The scan was recorded but was NOT deducted from your package.
inconclusive.hint: Try retaking it following the guide: hold the phone parallel to the litter surface, use good light and focus clearly on the color-changed granules.

scale.statusColorNote: Colors on the scale show pH zones; the marker uses the granule color the system measured.

advice.title: What should you do?
advice.routineBody: Scan again in a few days so CatCheck can compare with your cat's own usual readings.
advice.waterBody: Keep fresh, clean water available and change it often so your cat drinks enough every day.

retry.blurry: The photo is blurry — hold the phone steady and retake it in good light.
retry.generic: Couldn't read the indicator granule color — take a closer shot of the color-changed litter area.
retry.out_of_chart: Color-changed granules were detected, but the color is outside the current reference chart. Include the color card in the photo for a more accurate comparison.
retry.low_confidence: Color-changed granules were detected, but confidence isn't high enough to estimate pH. Try again in even lighting or include the color card in the photo.

quality.BLURRY: The photo is blurry — hold the phone steady when shooting.
quality.TOO_DARK: The photo is too dark — shoot somewhere with enough light.
quality.TOO_BRIGHT: The photo is too bright — avoid backlighting or direct flash.
quality.OVEREXPOSED: The indicator granule area is overexposed.
quality.UNDEREXPOSED_PATCH: Part of the photo is underexposed.
quality.UNEVEN_LIGHTING: Lighting is uneven across the photo.
quality.CARD_NOT_FOUND: No reference color card found in the frame — accuracy will be lower.
quality.CALIBRATION_UNAVAILABLE: Not enough background litter to calibrate color.
quality.LOW_GRANULE_COVERAGE: There's only a small area of indicator granules in the frame.
quality.NO_INDICATOR_GRAINS: No color-changed indicator granules were detected in the photo.
quality.FEW_BLOBS: Only a few indicator granules were detected.
quality.MIXED_COLORS: Indicator granule colors are inconsistent in the photo.
quality.OUT_OF_CHART_RANGE: The measured color is outside the reference color chart.

REPEATED_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: pH has been outside the reference range several times recently.

BASELINE_DEVIATION.message: pH differs noticeably from your cat's usual baseline.

MONOTONIC_TREND.message: pH is steadily shifting in one direction.

LOW_QUALITY_STREAK.message: Several recent scans had low confidence — consider retaking photos following the guide.

URGENT_CLINICAL_SIGN.message: You reported an urgent clinical sign.

reassignCat.heading: Which cat should this result be reassigned to?
reassignCat.description: You can reassign within 24 hours, up to 3 times per scan.
reassignCat.limitReached: No reassignments left for this scan (up to 3 times per 24 hours).
reassignCat.windowClosed: The reassignment window for this scan has passed (within 24 hours of capture).
reassignCat.noOtherCat: There are no other cats to reassign to.

dispute.title: Is this result inaccurate?
dispute.success: Feedback received — this scan won't be counted in the trend chart.

note.tooLong: Notes can be at most 500 characters.

scanDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this scan? The original photo will be permanently deleted.
scanDetail.actionError: That didn't work. Please try again.

web.pageSubtitle: Take or upload a photo of the color-changed litter area so CatCheck can estimate your cat's pH.
web.sharedTrayHint: The result is saved to the shared tray log and isn't attached to any cat.
web.frameEmpty: No photo yet. Take or upload a photo of the color-changed litter area.
web.tip1: Shoot in natural white light and avoid shadows.
web.tip2: Take the photo within 5-15 minutes after your cat uses the tray so the color doesn't change.
web.spectrumSubtitle: CatCheck's pH classification bands. The black dot marks this scan.
web.spectrumSubtitleAwaiting: CatCheck's pH classification bands — your result will be marked on this scale.
web.nearBoundary: The value is close to the boundary between two bands — consider scanning again to compare.
web.awaitingBody: Take or upload a photo of the color-changed litter area, then tap analyze to see the result here.
web.imageAlt: Litter area photo from this scan
web.imageNotStored: The photo for this scan wasn't stored.

outOfCredit.title: You've used all the scans in your package
outOfCredit.body: A new scan needs 1 credit. Activate the code on your litter bag to keep scanning.
outOfCredit.noPackage: You haven't activated a package yet — you're using trial scans.
outOfCredit.activateHint: Activate the code printed on your litter bag to get credits for your next scan.
outOfCredit.note: Running out of credits only locks new scans. Your history, cat profiles and saved charts are still available as usual.

imageReason.TRIAL: Trial scans don't store the original photo.
imageReason.PLAN_OFF: The package at the time of the scan didn't include original photo storage.
imageReason.CONSENT_OFF: You turned off consent to store scan photos.
imageReason.INCONCLUSIVE: The photo didn't meet quality requirements, so it wasn't stored.
